# isoplane setup

Sets up Isoplane's tooling on this machine.

```bash
isoplane setup [options]
```

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `--source <source>` | Release directory or URL. |
| `-y, --yes` | Install missing native prerequisites and agree to Microsoft's license terms for its Debug Adapter Protocol library, without prompting. |
